name: Nakenai Usagi
source:
―There is no such thing as God.

There is a legend of a goddess who was worshipped long ago and her existence is now forgotten. It is said that the goddess could grant any wish.

There is no such thing as God. But if wishes really do come true...

Clinging to a straw, he wandered into the forest and met a beautiful woman who lived up to the legend. When the goddess heard his wish, she smiled and said,

"Kneel down. And if you lick my shoes, I'll think about it."

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/1442]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——神并不存在。

传说中，有一位女神曾在很久以前受人供奉，如今却已被遗忘。据说，她能实现任何愿望。

神并不存在。但如果，愿望真的能够实现……

如同抓住救命稻草一般，他走进森林，遇见了一位如传说中那般美丽的女子。女神听过他的愿望，微笑着说：

“跪下。舔我的鞋子，我就考虑一下。”

[摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/1442]NovelGame[/url]]
